name.description: Series name used for displaying in tooltip and filtering with legend.

data.description:
An array of data that will be charted. Each value must be an array with at least two elements:
[x-value, y-value, ...additional-dimensions], where the x- and y-values are required. Additional dimensions
are not required, but may be included to add color and/or size to the points or to render data in the tooltip.

dimensions.description:
An ordered array of the field names that correspond to the positions of each element in a row of #data.

See {@link https://echarts.apache.org/en/option.html#series-scatter.dimensions}

symbolSize.description:
The size of the symbol that will be used to render each point. This may be represented as a number that will be
used for all data points or as a callback function that will take the data for each data point must return a
number based on the data. This is useful for relative scaling of the symbols.

See {@link https://echarts.apache.org/en/option.html#series-scatter.symbolSize}

title:
